name: Přibyslavice
text: Přibyslavice, also known as Bývalá obec Přibyslavice (English: The former village of Přibyslavice), is a former village in the municipality of Stříbrná Skalice in the Central Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic.

depictions.name: Pribyslavitz
depictions.text: The village of Pribyslavitz (In Czech "Přibyslavice") belonged to Sir Divish of Talmberg, until 1391, when Havel Medek of Valdek imprisoned him in the nearby castle of Talmberg and torched the village, which would remain abandoned after his escape. After the Battle of Pribyslavitz, the village would later be rebuilt by Henry after he is appointed Bailiff of Pribyslavitz by Sir Divish.
